We believe these credit losses are manageable within the context of the bank's earnings power, and that the long-term franchise value remains intact despite the prevailing industry pessimism [D01, D02, D03].

final.memo:
Charlie and I have long admired businesses that demonstrate consistent performance through discipline, and this bank is a prime example of such an institution [D01, D02]. We understand the banking model well—taking deposits and lending—and we find that this specific business has operated with remarkable efficiency, evidenced by a historical return on equity consistently exceeding 20% [D01, D02].

Unlike many of its peers, management here emphasizes expense discipline rather than growth for its own sake [D01]. This focus is vital, as it ensures the bank maintains significant pre-provision earnings capacity, which serves as a powerful buffer against the cyclical nature of credit losses [D01, D02]. While the market is currently fearful of the California real estate environment, we believe this pessimism has created an opportunity to purchase a high-quality franchise at a bargain price [D01, D05].

We are currently able to acquire an interest in this business at less than 3x pretax earnings, a price that provides a comfortable margin of safety [D04]. When we see a wonderful business offered at a price this low, we are not interested in timing the market or guessing when the broader sector concerns might abate; we simply recognize that the current valuation is far removed from the intrinsic value of the underlying earnings power [D03, D04].

Our investment represents a long-term commitment to a well-managed franchise [D01]. We recognize the risks inherent in geographic concentration, but we believe the bank’s resilience in the face of recent economic challenges confirms our confidence [D03, D05]. We intend to hold this position as a permanent, passive investment as long as management continues to act like owners and maintains the disciplined culture that has served shareholders so well in the past [D01, D04].
